label: About
title: About Haunted Sprite Threshold
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 551 recent saved-signal files and 82 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around @BiggeeSmols: I just launched my first collection on @vvvdotso Lavender Town and @de3dsoul: tweet 2086140016959357344, plus 7 more. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Haunted Sprite Threshold: Haunted grayscale sprite threshold, game-space surface composition archetype, shallow macro camera plate grammar. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 9 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against white eye slits inside the smoky mask, crescent rim and bright rupture on the shield, and small square breaks along the midline rail.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
